name: sst-monorepo-starter

scripts.clean: pnpm -r exec -- rm -rf node_modules .turbo 2>/dev/null || true && rm -rf node_modules .turbo && rm -f pnpm-lock.yaml
scripts.dev: uv sync --all-packages && pnpm sst dev --stage int
scripts.agent:python: bash -lc 'cd packages/agent-core && if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then .venv/bin/python src/agent.py; else python3 src/agent.py; fi'
scripts.test:api: cd packages/rest-api && uv sync --dev && uv run pytest
scripts.api:local: cd packages/rest-api && uv sync --dev && uv run uvicorn homehub_api.dev:app --reload --port 8000 --app-dir src
scripts.verify: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build

description: HomeHub — smart home IoT hub with REST API, DynamoDB, Cognito, and SST IaC
